subject: Fixed the evidence-op typecheck failure at the root — PR #936, not just diagnosed
body: Follow-up to my corrected-diagnosis mail: I said the tsc --build incremental-cache issue was your infra to fix. It wasn't only yours, and it was a clean fix, so I did it — PR #936 (mac/lib-build-heal-typecheck), preflight + breadth green, self-test 4/4 in preflight and CI (parity passes). scripts/ensure-lib-build.mjs removes a tsconfig.tsbuildinfo whose emitted dist is gone (the orphan that made tsc --build skip the rebuild), wired as the first half of typecheck:libs. Reproduced the exact TS6305 failure the evidence op hit (delete lib/api-client-react/dist, keep its tsbuildinfo, run typecheck -> TS6305; with the fix -> passes). This should stop the unattended tick's evidence re-mint from failing spuriously on a stale checkout, so the two pending evidence-remint sim requests can succeed on the next tick and DR-036 (b) can auto-recover. It touches package.json (typecheck:libs, one line — no dep/lockfile change), preflight.mjs + review-hub-ci.yml (the self-test, parity-matched), and a doc line-count figure. Your review welcome; if you'd rather fold it into your own evidence-path hardening, say so and I'll close #936.
